messages:
Sam: Quick note — pushed a dark-mode pass for code panels + chart palettes to the prototype. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.local/dark-syntax-ux.png
Maria: Nice, saw it. Overall +1 on the darker background, but the function name color looks too muted on small screens. contrast feels off.
Kevin: Which token are you seeing? I mapped tokens like this: `keyword: #7DD3FC`, `function: #A78BFA`, `string: #FBBF24`, `type: #34D399`.
Maria: It’s the `function` one — on 13" MacBook Retina the purple reads almost gray at 12px. Contrast ratio against bg `#0B0F13` seems under 4.5:1. Could we try a slightly brighter tint?
Lia: Repro: I ran the color-contrast chrome extension — `#A78BFA` vs `#0B0F13` = 3.2:1 for normal text. For small UI code we need 4.5:1 (accessibility nit).
Sam: Thanks, Lia. Two asks: 1) bump function color to hit 4.5:1, 2) ensure chart line overlays still look distinct from token colors (avoid accidental color collisions).
Kevin: Ok will adjust. Proposal: `function: #C084FC` (brighter), `keyword: #60A5FA` (slightly dimmer), keep `string` warm. Anyone worried about the palette becoming too candy-colored?
Maria: I like `#C084FC` better. But check chart heatmap — we used a purple stop for high values and orange for mids; if function tokens go purple it may clash.
Sam: Good catch. For charts we can move away from purple for high-value stops. Suggest heatmap stops: `low: #071029`, `mid: #FFB366`, `high: #FF6B6B` (warm emphasis). That keeps purple for syntax only.
Lia: Also a nit: code block gutter line numbers are 10% opacity white — when you increase function color brightness it makes numbers pop less. Either darken the gutter or increase number opacity to 40%.
Kevin: I'll try two variants and drop them in the prototype branch: `gutter` option A `#0F1720` with line numbers `rgba(255,255,255,0.4)`, option B `#0B0F13` with `rgba(255,255,255,0.6)`.
Maria: Can you include a diff snippet in the PR? e.g.:
```
/* syntax tokens */
-- function: #A78BFA
++ function: #C084FC
/* heatmap stops */
-- high: #6B21A8
++ high: #FF6B6B
```
Sam: Please also add a short QA checklist in the PR description: device sizes to test (13" mac, 14" Windows, iPad), screen brightness ranges, and accessibility contrast numbers.
design-bot: New prototype updated: https://app.redwood.design/proto/dark-syntax-v2 (changed 4 files) :sparkles:
Kevin: PR opened: https://git.redwood.local/p/r/1427 — includes two palette variants + screenshots. Would love quick thumbs before EOD.
Maria: Review done — prefer Variant A for gutters and Variant 2 for chart stops (warm high). Left inline comments on PR. :thumbsup:
Sam: Great. Follow-ups for next week: 1) consider a user preference toggle "high-contrast code" in settings, 2) doc copy for theming (explain "optimized for readability vs brand vibrancy").
Lia: Also add keyboard-only focus styles for code tokens (outline on token hover isn't visible in dark). Maybe `box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(96,165,250,0.15)` around the focused token.
Kevin: Noted. Merging Variant A as draft so we can user-test tomorrow. Will post results.
Sam: Thanks everyone! :rocket:
